title: Design System: Lakshya Jain — Personal Site

display.purpose: Headline-scale moments only: hero name (the system's one skewed element), section openers, archive-row titles.

body.purpose: Reading-length prose: descriptions, hero subhead, footer, About lead paragraph.

label.purpose: Anything numbered, labeled, or measured: nav, status readouts, data-panel fields, tag chips.

motion.name: fold-deploy
motion.value: scale(0.09) rotate(-6deg) -> scale(1) rotate(0deg), 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 0.15s both
motion.purpose: The hero crease field's one-time load-in growth; the system's single authored motion moment.

motion.name: fold-facet-in
motion.purpose: Per-facet fade-in inside the crease field, staggered by grid distance from the origin corner.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Default hover treatment for all filled buttons.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: The status-ready dot (Hero 'Ready', Contact 'Channel open'); disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Gold Button (primary)
components.description: Gold-filled parallelogram-cut CTA, e.g. the hero's 'Deploy — view work'.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #b08a2e; color: #111315; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b08a2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Button (secondary)
components.description: Ink-filled parallelogram-cut button, e.g. 'Get in touch' and the mobile nav toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: #111315; color: #f7f7f5; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; clip-path: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Plain-rectangle bordered tag, e.g. project tags on Work rows. Deliberately not cut.
components.css: .ds-tag-chip { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #5b5f66; border: 1px solid #111315; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 4px 10px; }

components.name: Sheet Panel
components.description: The signature data-panel card: single 45° gold-filled corner notch, hairline border, mono field list or figcaption.
components.css: .ds-sheet-panel { position: relative; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dcdcd8; clip-path: polygon(0 22px, 22px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-sheet-panel::before { position: absolute; content: ''; top: 0; left: 0; width: 22px; height: 22px; background: #b08a2e; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%); } .ds-panel-body { min-height: 200px; } .ds-panel-caption { border-top: 1px solid #dcdcd8; padding: 16px 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #5b5f66; }

components.description: Sticky translucent-blur nav with the gold parallelogram monogram wordmark.

narrative.overview: The site presents itself as precision-engineered hardware documentation, not a portfolio: every panel is cut like a Miura-fold deployment sheet, and the hero's signature move is a crease-pattern field that grows from a single origin point into a full mountain/valley tessellation on load — real SVG geometry, not a decorative loop. The world reads as aerospace-adjacent instrument literature: sheet-white ground, ink-black structure, a single foil-gold accent reserved for primary actions, and a data-blue reserved for live/status values. Corners are never rounded — every edge that isn't a plain rectangle is a deliberate parallelogram cut or a single 45°-notched corner, echoing a folded sheet's own geometry rather than soft app-UI chrome. This replaces the prior 'Live Paper' world outright — a full identity change chosen through a structured direction round, not a refinement.
keyCharacteristics: Cut, not rounded: every shape is a plain rectangle, a symmetric parallelogram cut, or a single 45° corner notch — zero border-radius anywhere.
One accent, one data color: foil-gold marks primary actions only; data-blue marks live/status values only.
Live geometry, not an image: the hero's crease-pattern field is real SVG, grown into place via one authored CSS animation on load.
Flat by default: no box-shadows anywhere — separation comes from contrast, hairline borders, and the gold corner-notch.

rules.name: The One Accent, One Data Rule
rules.body: Gold means act on this. Data-blue means this is live or current. A static label or structural element never borrows either color.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is reserved for headline-scale moments only; Plex Mono is reserved for anything labeled, numbered, or measured; Plex Sans carries everything else.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest and stays flat on hover; state changes are a translateY lift on buttons, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Gold reserved for primary-action fills only, and Data Blue reserved for live/status values only.
Do keep every cut shape at exactly 0 border-radius — parallelogram or single-corner-notch only, never rounded.
Do fill buttons instead of outlining them when a cut class is involved — border/shadow on a clipped element breaks visibly.
Do reserve the hero name's skew for that one element; every other headline stays upright.
Do keep the crease-field animation as the system's one authored motion moment.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label directly above a heading.
Don't add box-shadows or ambient elevation.
Don't reintroduce decorative sequence numbers (01, FIG. 0X).
